work.purpose: Verify the existing teacher application in a useful native Bot/Screen D1 development slice, retaining source-bound original observations, corrections and uncertain-outcome recovery without official effects.
changes: Opt-in scratch Unix-socket test PostgreSQL lane in the existing localhost rehearsal; default remains in-memory.
Original-request response guards prevent late recovery from regressing a newer correction.
Dirty or refused drafts do not silently adopt changed source/head revisions; explicit teacher reconciliation preserves local text.
Readback requires the exact idempotency key and predecessor revision.
Current date-class cases verify disabled unqualified refresh and no request instead of fabricating source qualification.
Advisory contract retains the observed trusted Lead model identifier literally, without changing native model selection or extending worker/reviewer controls.
Existing test script/cloud gate now consumes the new focused regressions.

botReview.nativeRestriction: existing agent.disabled_toolsets=[all] retained; no setting or SOUL change
limitations: No tools, filesystem access, edits, tests, browser actions, database operations or external actions were performed.
Reproductions are proposed bounded cases derived from the supplied source, not executed results.
No production, teacher, physical-device or independent deployment acceptance is claimed.
